g.text: SDK inventory-v2 — frozen successor, never an adaptive retry
attach only on spawn after core wiring
no subsequent retry or cap increase
No early flow, read, pause or resume operation
Counters saturate; mark incomplete on overflow
Observed Node packets are not OS syscall counts
V1 failure remains historical and unchanged
No adaptive parameter selection or fallback
verify transformed and fully linked hashes
observe existing data events without payload retention
every existing pipeline failure remains fatal
